product_metadata.title: Letheva UFO Bread Lame Cutter, for Scoring Homemade Dough, Great Gift for Artisan Bread and Baguette Makers, Our Scorer Includes 10 Replaceable Razor Blades, Must Baking Tool for Bread Baking
features: 🍞 LET'S MAKE SCORING BREAD FUN! Our bread slicers for homemade bread are much easier to use than a long-handled lame, that you'll love to score! This unique tool is the perfect baking gift for any sourdough bread loaf baker lover!

🥨 WANT TO GET ARTY WITH YOUR BREAD? This unique razor blade slashing tool will make you feel like an artist with a great paintbrush. Our bread scoring tool makes very easy to maneuver the blade to make beautiful slashes on delicate dough without deflating.
🥖 TAKE YOUR SCORING TO THE NEXT LEVEL! Our lame knife makes cutting dough most precise and accurate. Really easy to use and allows for excellent precision in scoring your dough

🥐 AFTER USING THIS TOOL, YOU'LL SCORE LIKE A PRO! Our bakers lame will allow you to get close to the dough surface for intricate scoring of small designs, and because you are holding a disc between your fingers and thumb from which the razor blade protrudes, you have way more control than when holding a stick/handle.

🏆 GUARANTEE & WHAT'S IN THE BOX, The set includes: 1 nice gift box, 1 felt pouch, 1 wood UFO bread lame and 10 razor blades. If for any reason you feel that our lame bread tool fell short of your expectation, simply return it for a full refund.
